display.purpose: Nix wordmark only; mobile size is defined by the responsive component.

metadata.purpose: Dates, reading time, tags and source links.

code.purpose: Monospaced preformatted content; smaller at mobile widths.

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Outlined Nix wordmark on the pale-blue masthead.
components.css: .ds-wordmark-surface { background: var(--sky, #dce7f6); padding: 9px 12px 10px; } .ds-wordmark, .ds-wordmark:visited { font: 800 44px/1 var(--ui, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--brand, #6698ce); -webkit-text-stroke: 1px var(--brand-stroke, #4b66ab); text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #f0f6ff; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-wordmark:hover { text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--link, #0000cc); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-wordmark { font-size: 38px; } }

components.name: Compact utility button
components.description: Sidebar search pagination and clear actions use this compact button treatment.
components.css: .ds-compact-button { padding: 4px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #b7c9e2); border-radius: 0; background: var(--subtle, #f2f5fa); color: var(--navy, #000080); font: 11px/1.35 var(--ui, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-compact-button:hover { background: var(--sky, #dce7f6); } .ds-compact-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--link, #0000cc); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-compact-button:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Sidebar search
components.description: Labeled white search field with an adjacent square magnifier button.
components.css: .ds-search { max-width: 240px; background: var(--sky, #dce7f6); padding: 12px 8px; font: 12px/1.35 var(--ui, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); } .ds-search-label { display: block; color: var(--navy, #000080); font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px; } .ds-search-control { display: flex; border: 1px solid var(--line, #b7c9e2); background: var(--paper, #ffffff); } .ds-search-input { min-width: 0; width: 100%; padding: 5px 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: var(--ui-size, 12px)/1.35 var(--ui, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #161616); caret-color: var(--link, #0000cc); } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #475977); } .ds-search-submit { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 29px; flex: none; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #b7c9e2); border-radius: 0; background: var(--subtle, #f2f5fa); color: var(--navy, #000080); cursor: pointer; } .ds-search-submit:hover { background: var(--sky, #dce7f6); } .ds-search-input:focus-visible, .ds-search-submit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--link, #0000cc); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-search-input { padding: 8px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-search-submit { width: 36px; } }

components.name: Markdown file navigation
components.description: Native folder disclosure with a linked folder name and current-file styling. Folders start collapsed unless configured in content.defaultExpandedFolders; browsing state is remembered until defaults change. Sample labels and the expanded preview state are illustrative.
components.html:
Folder
  • Note
components.css: .ds-tree { max-width: 240px; padding: 12px 8px; background: var(--sky, #dce7f6); font: var(--ui-size, 12px)/1.35 var(--ui, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); } .ds-folder-summary { list-style: none; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 2px; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.3; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-folder-summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-folder-summary:before { content: "+"; flex: none; width: 11px; height: 11px; margin-top: 2px; border: 1px solid #849bbd; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--navy, #000080); font: 10px/9px var(--mono, Consolas, monospace); text-align: center; } .ds-folder[open] > .ds-folder-summary:before { content: "−"; } .ds-folder-link, .ds-folder-link:visited { display: flex; gap: 5px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; color: var(--navy, #000080); text-decoration: none; } .ds-folder-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-folder-icon { display: inline-block; position: relative; flex: none; width: 13px; height: 10px; margin: 3px 1px 0 0; background: #e9cd81; border: 1px solid #9a7935; } .ds-folder-icon:before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -3px; left: -1px; width: 6px; height: 3px; border: 1px solid #9a7935; border-bottom: 0; background: #e9cd81; } .ds-tree-children { list-style: none; margin: 0 0 0 8px; padding: 0 0 0 7px; border-left: 1px dotted #9aaecb; } .ds-tree-item { margin: 0; } .ds-file-link { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 2px 4px 18px; color: var(--link, #0000cc); text-decoration: none; line-height: 1.3; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-file-link:visited { color: var(--visited, #67429a); } .ds-folder-summary:hover, .ds-file-link:hover { background: #c5d6ed; } .ds-file-link[aria-current="page"] { background: #bfd2ed; font-weight: bold; } .ds-file-icon { position: relative; display: inline-block; flex: none; width: 10px; height: 12px; margin: 1px 2px 0 1px; border: 1px solid #7993b7; background: #f8fbff; } .ds-file-icon:after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 2px; right: 2px; top: 3px; height: 1px; background: #a3b4cd; box-shadow: 0 3px #a3b4cd; } .ds-folder-summary:focus-visible, .ds-folder-link:focus-visible, .ds-file-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--link, #0000cc); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-folder-summary, .ds-file-link { min-height: 30px; padding-top: 7px; padding-bottom: 7px; } }

components.name: Plain tag links
components.description: Source tags render as ordinary hash-prefixed text links without chip containers.
components.css: .ds-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin: 7px 0 0; font: 11px/1.5 var(--ui, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); } .ds-tag-link { color: var(--link, #0000cc); text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tag-link:visited { color: var(--visited, #67429a); } .ds-tag-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-tag-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--link, #0000cc); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Table of contents
components.description: Heading-depth list; application scroll tracking applies the illustrated current-location state.
components.html:
On this page

  1. Overview
  2. Current section
Back to top ↑
components.css: .ds-toc { max-width: 190px; font: var(--ui-size, 12px)/1.4 var(--ui, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); } .ds-toc-heading { color: var(--navy, #000080); font-size: var(--ui-size, 12px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #b7c9e2); padding-bottom: 6px; margin: 0 0 9px; } .ds-toc-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-toc-item { margin-bottom: 6px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-toc-nested { padding-left: 8px; } .ds-toc-link { color: var(--muted, #475977); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-toc-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-toc-link[aria-current="location"] { color: var(--navy, #000080); background: var(--subtle, #f2f5fa); font-weight: bold; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-toc-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--link, #0000cc); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-toc-top { display: block; margin-top: 15px; text-decoration: underline; }

components.name: Folder fallback table
components.description: Compact descendant file/date table; illustrative content does not create archive entries.
components.html:
FileAdded
Folder/NoteUndated
components.css: .ds-folder-table { width: 100%; max-width: 900px; table-layout: fixed; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--ink, #161616); font: var(--article-size, 16px)/1.45 var(--reading, "Times New Roman", Times, serif); } .ds-folder-cell { padding: 7px 8px; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #b7c9e2); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } th.ds-folder-cell { background: var(--sky, #dce7f6); font: bold var(--ui-size, 12px) var(--ui, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); } .ds-folder-date { width: 112px; } td.ds-folder-date { font: var(--ui-size, 12px)/1.5 var(--ui, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); color: var(--muted, #475977); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-folder-row:hover { background: var(--subtle, #f2f5fa); } .ds-folder-file { color: var(--link, #0000cc); text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-folder-file:visited { color: var(--visited, #67429a); } .ds-folder-file:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-folder-file:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--link, #0000cc); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Header external links
components.description: Known icons render as labeled inline SVG; unknown or absent icons use their text label.
components.html: Text fallback
components.css: .ds-external-nav { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px; font: var(--ui-size, 12px)/1.45 var(--ui, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif); } .ds-external-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 24px; min-height: 24px; color: var(--link, #0000cc); text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-external-link:visited { color: var(--visited, #67429a); } .ds-external-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-external-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--link, #0000cc); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-external-nav { gap: 7px; font-size: 11px; } .ds-external-link { min-width: 30px; min-height: 30px; } }

narrative.overview:
Nix is a compact, plainspoken reading environment with the early-2000s NirSoft character explicitly selected by the author. A pale-blue navigation area, navy headings, conventional links and a white document canvas establish its identity. Small Arial interface text supports Times New Roman reading copy.

The actual Markdown hierarchy gives the interface its structure. Visual treatment should make browsing files, reading a note, following a reference and searching feel immediate. Preserve source images and their authored context; the system requires no decorative raster imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Compact document density and familiar browser conventions.
Pale-blue navigation beside a white reading canvas.
Serif prose with small sans-serif controls and headings.
Square, flat controls and visible rules.
Navigation derived from the published Markdown hierarchy.

rules.name: The Configuration Rule
rules.body: Global palette and type settings come from `config.yaml`; templates consume the corresponding custom properties.

dos: **Do** preserve the compact NirSoft-inspired pale-blue, navy and white identity.
**Do** retain Times New Roman reading copy and Arial interface text.
**Do** derive navigation and authored pages from the published Markdown hierarchy.
**Do** keep keyboard focus visible and native reading and disclosure behavior usable.
**Do** preserve source images and center their captions.
**Do** use `config.yaml` for global site, content and theme settings.
donts: **Don't** introduce a separate primary menu, a visible content-root wrapper or invented topic folders.
**Don't** replace source-authored index pages with a custom marketing homepage.
**Don't** turn plain tags or document regions into pill controls or floating cards.
**Don't** replace familiar links with decorative action treatments.
**Don't** introduce decorative imagery or animation as a new visual identity.
